description: This is a Go source file implementing a benchmarking tool for the AgentField SDK. It includes functions for measuring registration time, memory footprint, cold start time, request latency, and throughput, with detailed statistical analysis and server mode operation.

methods.name: calculateStats
methods.description: Calculates statistical measures (mean, stddev, min, max, percentiles) for a slice of float64 data.

methods.name: percentile
methods.description: Computes the p-th percentile of a sorted slice of float64.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs various benchmarks and outputs results, optionally starting a server.

methods.name: benchmarkRegistration
methods.description: Measures the time to register a specified number of handlers multiple times.

methods.name: benchmarkMemory
methods.description: Measures memory usage when creating an agent and registering handlers.

methods.name: benchmarkColdStart
methods.description: Measures the time to create an agent instance (cold start).

methods.name: benchmarkRequestProcessing
methods.description: Measures latency of processing individual requests through registered handlers.

methods.name: runServer
methods.description: Starts a server with registered handlers and reports request throughput.

methods.name: benchmarkConcurrentRequests
methods.description: Performs a concurrent benchmark of handler invocation with specified concurrency and duration.
